purpose: Transfer Codex configuration and lifecycle ownership from Home Manager to standalone Codex
contract: Home Manager stops installing or rewriting Codex configuration and managing custom Codex daemon and GC
failureBoundary: Existing standalone Codex settings and unrelated clients must remain usable
falsifier: Home Manager still installs or mutates a Codex config or custom daemon/GC
nonGoals: Change live session state or unrelated client settings
invariants: Preserve runtime settings before switch and unrelated Home Manager config

assumptions.claim: Existing managed paths can be materialized before switch
assumptions.falsifier: A managed path cannot be copied or Home Manager removes its replacement
